items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: The Olympia band, Freddie Keppert. That was Freddie Keppert's band.

ctx.x: Were there any of the other real early bands that you remember hearing when you were a boy, aside from the Emmanuel Perez group? You mentioned the superior band with the…
The Olympia band, Freddie Keppert. That was Freddie Keppert's band. Yeah, the Olympia, the superior.
Remember who else was with Keppert when you'd hear him? I don't know those guys at all. I didn't know them.
